title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Ueno Gakuen Hall, Hiroshima | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Ueno Gakuen Hall in Hiroshima, Japan, on 29 March 2019.

It was the third show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘What Goes On’

  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)

  • ‘Photograph’

  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
